integrity: Stand-alone complete finite enumerations and exact integer unit-pivot reductions; general n>=7 follows a triple-distance inequality. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the full binary cubes in dimensions n>=5 and thresholds n-1,n-2 are covered. Homology, not exact homotopy, is established at n=5,6. No integral equivariant classification or full filtration, and one ordinary-Rips preprint was available only through its abstract.
title: Integral anti-Rips homology and a sharp persistence transition on Boolean cubes
